description: This file contains unit tests for the 'AuthProviderChain' class, which manages multiple authentication providers with priority-based resolution. The tests verify authentication logic across different provider configurations, including single and multiple provider scenarios, as well as handling of provider addition conflicts.

classes.name: AuthProviderChainTest
classes.description: Test suite for the AuthProviderChain class, covering provider addition, priority conflicts, and authentication flow resolution.

classes.name: DebugAuthProvider
classes.description: A mock authentication provider that always authenticates successfully with configurable priority.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: A mock authentication provider that authenticates if username equals password, with configurable priority.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A mock LDAP authentication provider with priority, authenticating if username equals password.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithOneProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication with a single provider.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingFirstProvider
methods.description: Verifies that the chain correctly resolves to the first provider with a successful authentication.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingSecondProvider
methods.description: Verifies that the chain correctly resolves to the second provider when the first fails.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingLastProvider
methods.description: Verifies that the chain correctly resolves to the last provider when others fail.

methods.name: testAddProviderWithMultipleProvidersWithSamePriority
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when adding a provider with a conflicting priority.

methods.name: testAddProvider
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when adding a duplicate provider instance.
